data: Le Goût des merveilles (A Sense of Wonder)

Au coeur de la Drôme provençale, Louise élève seule ses deux enfants et tente de préserver l’exploitation familiale. Un soir, elle manque d’écraser un inconnu au comportement singulier. Cet homme se révèle vite différent de la plupart des gens. Et sa capacité d’émerveillement pourrait bien changer la vie de Louise et de sa famille. (In the heart of the Drôme in Provence, Louise raises her two children alone while trying to maintain and run the family farm. One evening, she narrowly misses running over a stranger. The man quickly reveals himself to be very different from most other people. And his ability to be amazed may indeed change life for Louise and her family.)

In the heart of the Drôme in Provence, Louise raises her two children alone while trying to maintain and run the family farm. One evening, she narrowly misses running over a stranger. The man quickly reveals himself to be very different from most other people. And his ability to be amazed may indeed change life for Louise and her family.
